text: How many women have won a Nobel Prize?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS women_laureates FROM laureates WHERE gender = 'female'

text: Which categories have the most prizes?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(*) AS awards FROM awards a JOIN prizes p ON p.prize_id = a.prize_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY awards DESC

text: Women and men laureates by decade
sql: SELECT p.decade, l.gender, COUNT(*) AS laureates FROM awards a JOIN prizes p ON p.prize_id = a.prize_id JOIN laureates l ON l.laureate_id = a.laureate_id WHERE l.kind = 'person' GROUP BY p.decade, l.gender ORDER BY p.decade

text: How old are laureates when they win?
sql: SELECT (age_at_award / 5) * 5 AS age_band, COUNT(*) AS laureates FROM awards WHERE age_at_award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY age_band ORDER BY age_band

text: Are laureates getting older? Age at award by year
sql: SELECT p.award_year, a.age_at_award, c.name AS category, l.name AS laureate FROM awards a JOIN prizes p ON p.prize_id = a.prize_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN laureates l ON l.laureate_id = a.laureate_id WHERE a.age_at_award IS NOT NULL

rows: Robert Cecil, Viscount Cecil of Chelwood

text: Which countries were the most laureates born in?
sql: SELECT co.country_code, co.name AS country, COUNT(*) AS laureates FROM laureates l JOIN countries co ON co.country_code = l.birth_country_code GROUP BY co.country_code, co.name ORDER BY laureates DESC

text: Where were physics laureates born?
sql: SELECT l.name AS laureate, l.birth_city, l.birth_latitude AS latitude, l.birth_longitude AS longitude, p.award_year FROM awards a JOIN prizes p ON p.prize_id = a.prize_id JOIN laureates l ON l.laureate_id = a.laureate_id WHERE p.category_id = 'phy' AND l.birth_latitude IS NOT NULL

text: Top 10 universities by Nobel prizes
sql: SELECT af.name AS institution, co.name AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.award_id) AS prizes FROM affiliations af JOIN award_affiliations aa ON aa.affiliation_id = af.affiliation_id LEFT JOIN countries co ON co.country_code = af.country_code GROUP BY af.affiliation_id ORDER BY prizes DESC LIMIT 10

text: Prize money over time, adjusted for inflation
sql: SELECT award_year, MAX(prize_amount_adj_sek) AS prize_amount_adj_sek FROM prizes GROUP BY award_year ORDER BY award_year

text: Prizes by category and decade
sql: SELECT p.decade, c.name AS category, COUNT(*) AS awards FROM awards a JOIN prizes p ON p.prize_id = a.prize_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY p.decade, c.name ORDER BY p.decade

text: Average age at award per decade
sql: SELECT decade, ROUND(AVG(age_at_award), 1) AS avg_age FROM award_facts WHERE age_at_award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY decade ORDER BY decade

text: What's the world population right now?
sql: SELECT year, population FROM aggregate_year WHERE aggregate_code = 'WLD' AND population IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 1

text: Life expectancy by region since 1960
sql: SELECT ay.year, ag.name AS region, ay.life_expectancy FROM aggregate_year ay JOIN aggregates ag ON ag.aggregate_code = ay.aggregate_code WHERE ag.kind = 'region' AND ay.life_expectancy IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ay.year

text: Internet users around the world

text: Top 10 CO2 emitters
sql: SELECT c.name AS country, ROUND(cy.co2_total_mt) AS co2_mt FROM country_year cy JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = cy.country_code WHERE cy.year = 2024 AND cy.co2_total_mt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cy.co2_total_mt DESC LIMIT 10

text: How is the world's population split by income group?
sql: SELECT ag.name AS income_group, ay.population FROM aggregate_year ay JOIN aggregates ag ON ag.aggregate_code = ay.aggregate_code WHERE ag.kind = 'income' AND ay.year = 2024 ORDER BY ay.population DESC

text: Australia vs New Zealand vs Canada: GDP per person since 1990
sql: SELECT cy.year, c.name AS country, cy.gdp_per_capita_usd FROM country_year cy JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = cy.country_code WHERE c.name IN ('Australia', 'New Zealand', 'Canada') AND cy.year >= 1990 ORDER BY cy.year

text: How many children per woman across countries?
sql: SELECT CAST(fertility_rate * 2 AS INTEGER) / 2.0 AS births_per_woman, COUNT(*) AS countries FROM country_year WHERE year = 2024 AND fertility_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY births_per_woman ORDER BY births_per_woman

text: Where do people still lack electricity?
sql: SELECT cy.country_code, c.name AS country, cy.electricity_access_pct FROM country_year cy JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = cy.country_code WHERE cy.year = 2024 AND cy.electricity_access_pct IS NOT NULL

text: Which clubs have won the most premierships?
sql: SELECT c.name AS club, COUNT(*) AS premierships FROM seasons s JOIN clubs c ON c.club_id = s.premier_club_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY premierships DESC LIMIT 10

text: Average winning margin by season
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(AVG(margin), 1) AS avg_margin FROM matches WHERE is_draw = 0 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

text: Show every AFL venue on a map
sql: SELECT name, city, state, latitude, longitude, matches_hosted FROM venues WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY matches_hosted DESC

text: List the matches with the biggest winning margins
sql: SELECT m.year, hc.name AS home_club, m.home_score, ac.name AS away_club, m.away_score, m.margin FROM matches m JOIN clubs hc ON hc.club_id = m.home_club_id JOIN clubs ac ON ac.club_id = m.away_club_id ORDER BY m.margin DESC LIMIT 10

text: What fraction of matches end in a home victory, an away victory, or a draw?
sql: SELECT winner_side, COUNT(*) AS matches FROM matches GROUP BY winner_side

text: Distribution of total match scores
sql: SELECT (total_score / 20) * 20 AS score_band, COUNT(*) AS matches FROM matches GROUP BY score_band ORDER BY score_band

text: Collingwood's wins per season since 2000
sql: SELECT year, wins FROM ladder WHERE club_id = 4 AND year >= 2000 ORDER BY year

text: Ladder positions of the Swans by year
sql: SELECT year, position FROM ladder WHERE club_id = 16 ORDER BY year

text: How many premierships has Essendon won?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS premierships FROM seasons s JOIN clubs c ON c.club_id = s.premier_club_id WHERE c.name = 'Essendon'

text: Show the margin and total score for every Grand Final
sql: SELECT m.year, m.margin, m.total_score, hc.name AS home_club, ac.name AS away_club FROM matches m JOIN clubs hc ON hc.club_id = m.home_club_id JOIN clubs ac ON ac.club_id = m.away_club_id WHERE m.is_grand_final = 1 ORDER BY m.year

text: Matches hosted by state
sql: SELECT v.state, COUNT(*) AS matches FROM matches m JOIN venues v ON v.venue_id = m.venue_id WHERE v.state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.state ORDER BY matches DESC

text: Grand final margins over time
sql: SELECT year, margin FROM matches WHERE is_grand_final = 1 ORDER BY year

text: How many songs are on each album?
sql: SELECT a.title AS album, COUNT(*) AS songs FROM songs s JOIN albums a ON a.album_id = s.album_id GROUP BY a.album_id ORDER BY songs DESC

text: Total minutes by album
sql: SELECT title AS album, total_minutes FROM albums ORDER BY total_minutes DESC

text: Share of vault tracks by album
sql: SELECT a.title AS album, COUNT(*) AS vault_tracks FROM songs s JOIN albums a ON a.album_id = s.album_id WHERE s.is_vault_track = 1 GROUP BY a.album_id ORDER BY vault_tracks DESC

text: How many awards has Taylor Swift won?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS awards_won FROM awards

text: Top 10 songwriters by songs co-written with Taylor Swift
sql: SELECT p.name AS songwriter, COUNT(*) AS songs FROM credits c JOIN people p ON p.person_id = c.person_id WHERE p.name <> 'Taylor Swift' GROUP BY c.person_id ORDER BY songs DESC LIMIT 10

text: Where did the Eras Tour play?
sql: SELECT ts.city, ts.country_code, ts.venue, ts.latitude, ts.longitude FROM tour_shows ts JOIN tours t ON t.tour_id = ts.tour_id WHERE t.name = 'The Eras Tour' AND ts.latitude IS NOT NULL

text: Eras Tour shows by country
sql: SELECT ts.country_code, COUNT(*) AS shows FROM tour_shows ts JOIN tours t ON t.tour_id = ts.tour_id WHERE t.name = 'The Eras Tour' GROUP BY ts.country_code

text: Distribution of song lengths
sql: SELECT (duration_s / 30) * 30 AS bucket_s, COUNT(*) AS songs FROM songs WHERE duration_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bucket_s ORDER BY bucket_s

text: How many Easter eggs are there per album?
sql: SELECT a.title AS album, COUNT(*) AS easter_eggs FROM easter_eggs e JOIN albums a ON a.album_id = e.album_id GROUP BY a.album_id ORDER BY easter_eggs DESC

text: Top 10 longest songs
sql: SELECT s.title AS song, a.title AS album, s.duration_s FROM songs s JOIN albums a ON a.album_id = s.album_id ORDER BY s.duration_s DESC LIMIT 10

text: Top tours by total attendance
sql: SELECT name AS tour, total_attendance FROM tours ORDER BY total_attendance DESC

text: Awards by ceremony
sql: SELECT ceremony, COUNT(*) AS awards FROM awards GROUP BY ceremony ORDER BY awards DESC
